#define arch_timer_reg_read_stable(reg) ({                                  \
    u64 val;                                                              \
    if (needs_unstable_timer_counter_workaround()) {                      \
        preempt_disable();                                                \
        typeof(reg##_read) reg##_read = __this_cpu_read(reg##_read);      \
        if (reg##_read)                                                   \
            val = reg##_read();                                           \
        else                                                              \
            val = read_sysreg(reg);                                       \
        preempt_enable();                                                 \
    } else {                                                              \
        val = read_sysreg(reg);                                           \
    }                                                                     \
    val;                                                                  \
})

#define arch_timer_reg_read_stable(reg) ({ \
    u64 __val; \
    if (needs_unstable_timer_counter_workaround()) { \
        preempt_disable(); \
        void (*__workaround_fn)(void) = __this_cpu_read(timer_workaround_fn); \
        if (__workaround_fn) { \
            __workaround_fn(); \
        } \
        __val = read_sysreg(reg); \
        preempt_enable(); \
    } else { \
        __val = read_sysreg(reg); \
    } \
    __val; \
})

#define arch_timer_reg_read_stable(reg) ({ \
    u64 __val; \
    if (needs_unstable_timer_counter_workaround()) { \
        preempt_disable(); \
        typeof(arch_timer_reg_read) __workaround_func = \
            __this_cpu_read(timer_workaround_func); \
        if (__workaround_func) \
            __val = __workaround_func(reg); \
        else \
            __val = read_sysreg(reg); \
        preempt_enable(); \
    } else { \
        __val = read_sysreg(reg); \
    } \
    __val; \
})
